issue.title: Pull a note's ready tasks with a lone @route capture
issue.description: Capturing a lone `@foobar` item (in `bob capture` or Bob Mac Capture) opens the existing successor Pull-In choice. It lists every ready task that resides in `foobar.md`, previews where each would land, and links only the picked tasks into today's Pomodoros. The flow is atomic, explicit, and presented with one copy and visual system on every surface.
